rule: refuse if (dense_sim < dense_min AND bm25_max < bm25_min) OR non_diagnostic_intent_dominant

threshold_rationale.dense_min: midpoint of max DEV general-out-of-scope dense_sim (0.213, 'how much does this truck cost') and min DEV in-scope dense_sim (0.251, 'soot trap is completely blocked up')
threshold_rationale.bm25_min: midpoint of max DEV general-out-of-scope bm25_max (5.63, 'what is the capital of France') and the lowest bm25_max among the in-scope queries nearest the dense threshold (~11.6), keeping BM25 a real second pass-route for paraphrases
threshold_rationale.vehicle_adjacent_oos: d030 warranty (0.322/8.74) and d033 injectors in stock (0.323/10.61) sit inside the in-scope range on BOTH signals; no signal threshold refuses them without blocking in-scope queries, so reason (b) handles them
